collection.title: Mini Roadster 2012 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Mini Roadster 2012 Onwards model which requires a 20" wiper blade on the drivers side and the passengers side. This model uses the Pinch Tab arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also have the rear blade for this Paceman, simply click the Rear Blades tab below.

image.alt: Mini Roadster 2012 to 2024 Windscreen Wiper Blades
